name: Cursor click
what: A button pops in, a cursor glides to it on a curve, presses (a dip and a ripple) and the button changes - Subscribe turns grey Subscribed and a bell pops and rings.

learned_from.what: the cursor gliding to the button, the dip and the soft ripple
the red subscribe button and the cursor (a still capture)
the name above the button, Subscribed (a still capture)

motion: button back.out 12 f; the cursor glides 26 f (x power2.out, y S-curve = a curve); press 4 f, release 6 f; ripple 18 f; the bell back.out 10 f and rings
